launch_condition: New exploratory run registered after the complete prompt-only diagnostic. V1 correctly skipped and remains preserved. Start only after the exact completed diagnostic and a free exclusive GPU lock.
hypothesis: After explicit formatting repairs the syntactic floor, one shared train-only semantic planner initialization may enable useful constraint consumption. Parser utility remains an empirical question; no positive-result launch or checkpoint selection.
target: Verified minimal witness plans for E/I, default plans for N. This teaches task semantics as well as format; do not describe it as pure format supervision.
comparison: All evaluation arms share the identical final planner adapter. Same saved first-stage calls, same output instruction, same panel and decoding. No evaluation-based checkpoint selection.
budget: One epoch on 384 rows, exactly 96 optimizer steps if complete. Stop at 30-minute training cap and preserve partial checkpoint; do not evaluate an incomplete training run as the registered final model. Evaluation first 30-call gate, then at most 720 calls/one hour.
interpretation: Exploratory recovery on previously exposed dev. A shared direct-input-trained planner may favor direct input; this is a controlled initialization, not a claim that auxiliary representations received matched training. Later input-by-training factorial comparisons are still required.
